notes: 1930 three-storey mid-grey stucco building. A round bow bay over the north (viewer's right) half on both upper storeys, five narrow white-framed sashes around the bow; one round-arched dark window at the left of storey 2; white moulded belt over the street storey; red clay-tile parapet pent; ground (viewer's left to right): plain wood panel door, recessed dark double entry, small grey service door. Fractions from the real viewer's left. Street storey same mid-grey under the white belt; storey-2 arch reads as a deep dark round-headed opening (dark arch glazing + dark infill); boarded brown door and small grey panel as closed panels, dark double entry. Mid/dark grey stucco #7c7d80 (lum ~0.16). Wall lifted to #7c7d80; mirror skipped; lancet tracery and string course on the bow not expressible. Bow rebuilt through hyB swell (true curved plan, five casement panes a storey with a lower-sash/upper-sash bar, corbel foot), continuous thin white string course across the full width, storey-3 flat window removed (blank wall). Gothic tracery only approximated by bars. Wall #808385; bow underside corbel removed so the bay sits flush on the belt; centre double door is a closed dark leaf. Gothic casement tracery still not expressible. Wall #808385, flush bay foot and arch already. Applied: centre recessed entry a dark blank #2a2b2e (no pale panel), red lamp dot left of it, belt/trim lighter grey #d2d3d4. Gothic arched casement heads on the bow not expressible (hyB swell has flat heads); arch at storey 2 kept. Clapboard fix (2026-10-02): painted siding moved from the stained-timber wood-siding base to painted-clapboard so the tint renders as paint, not olive. Tint lift (2026-10-02): wall tints lifted toward the sunlit paint (t' = 1-(1-t)k). Base fix (2026-10-03): cool/grey wallTint = target / painted-stucco base so the warm stucco albedo does not turn it pink. GroundBand lift (2026-10-03): groundBand tint #808385 -> #999c9d (same rule as walls; it was missed by the first colour pass).
